postings.medium: White chalk on cast-iron steam pipe
postings.content: IF YOU TOUCH THE DRAFT LEVER WITH WET GLOVES, YOU SHOVEL TWO TONS OF LIGNITE ON SATURDAY. NO EXCEPTIONS. YES THIS MEANS YOU, DMITRI.

Attention all shifts: The brown speckles in the Tuesday hardtack are pine bark flour, not weevils. Weevils would have more protein. Soak biscuits in boiling brine for eight minutes before chewing if you value your molars.

postings.medium: Yellow grease crayon on metal cabinet
postings.content: Whoever 'borrowed' the 24mm box spanner to fix their bunk frame: bring it back before 18:00 or I will recalibrate the water pressure in Shower Stall 2 to thirty atmospheres cold.
postings.morale_effect: Spanner returned within 45 minutes; +5 Machine Shop speed

postings.medium: Scratched into concrete with a nail
postings.content: The Weigher's scale is made of brass, but his thumb is made of lead. A grain of wheat in the vault is worth ten tons of promise on the radio. Watch the ledgers.
Petition to relocate Sapper Stepan to the Generator Room. His snoring resonates at 50 Hz and vibrates the top four bunk frames. We thought the ceiling was collapsing twice last night.
postings.morale_effect: +4 Bunker laughter; Stepan gets earplugs for everyone

postings.medium: Neat fountain pen ink on official ledger sheet
postings.content: I do not have aspirin for your headaches. The headache is caused by stale air and twenty-hour shifts. Drink two cups of hot water, sleep for four hours on a wool blanket, and stop asking for iodine pills when your skin is merely dry from boiler steam.

postings.medium: Carved into soft lead gasket with a needle
postings.content: Left three dried sunflower seeds inside the blue relay box behind Filter 4. Don't eat them all at once. Meet me at 23:30 near the water meter when the pump cuts out.

postings.medium: Stenciled red spray lacquer on blast door
postings.content: All respirators will be hung by the harness straps with filters facing down. Anyone caught storing lard, dried tobacco, or playing cards inside their gas mask canister will forfeit their weekend lard ration.

Yes, I resoled your boots with strips of vulcanized conveyor belt. No, they will not bend at the ankle for three weeks. If you want Italian calfskin, go walk across the salt flats and buy some from the skeletons.
Blessed are those who turn the blower crank in the second hour of night, for their children breathe without coughing. The stone remembers what the fire forgot.
WE WILL NOT DIG SECTOR 6 ON GRAY MUSHROOM SLURRY FOR THE FOURTH DAY IN A ROW. GIVE US DRIED ONIONS OR WE LEAVE THE PICKS IN THE GRAVEL AT NOON.
postings.morale_effect: Elena releases 2kg preserved wild alliums; crisis averted (+5 Morale)

postings.content: At 03:00 on freezing nights, listen at the cold rail. You can hear the wheels clicking from fifty kilometers north. A train that never reached the siding. It's carrying coal and butter, boys.

postings.medium: White chalk tallies under a carved cradle
postings.content: Birth #01 (Marta, 3.1 kg, healthy lungs) — Day 260. First baby born underground in Bunker 7. Her first sound was not a siren, but her father crying into a boiler rag. Welcome to the dark, little spark.
postings.morale_effect: +25 Massive Hope surge across the entire bunker

postings.content: To whoever is rolling cigarettes out of dried tea leaves and encyclopedia pages: Volume 'M-N' is now missing all pages on Metallurgy. If the forge burns down because you wanted to smoke 'Manganese', I will dock your butter ration until Year 5.

postings.medium: Carved into concrete with a cold chisel
postings.content: Ten years in the limestone is not a sentence; it is the winter before the thaw. We will plant the rye on the summit when the snow turns clear. Do not throw away the fruit stones.
Bounty: 1 sugar cube for every 10 gray cave slugs brought alive to the compost vat. Children under 12 only. Please stop bringing dead ones; they do not eat the rotting leaf mould.

postings.medium: Three different colored chalks in dialogue
postings.content:
[Shift 1]: Who left the bleed valve open overnight? The basin is a solid block of ice.
[Shift 2]: It wasn't us, Shift 1 forgot to stoke the flue.
[Dmitri]: Both of you are idiots. The pipe broke because it is -38 outside. I fixed it. You both owe me three cigarettes.
The wire recorder runs hot between 02:00 and 03:00 even when the antenna switch is thrown to GROUND. Someone is feeding a carrier into the earth lead from below the riverbed.

Winter Chess Championship Finals: Boris (White) vs. Harlan (Black). Stakes: 1 jar of pickled wild garlic against Harlan's silver belt buckle. Spectators must remain silent or Boris will drop a hot coal in your tea.

Here worked Grigory Morozov, who blew the river bridges so we could sleep in dry beds. He carried five hundred tons of rock in his boots and never complained about the dust. Rest in the bedrock, old badger.

postings.medium: Red paint tallies and finish line arrow
postings.content: Friday 20:00: The Sewer Grand Prix! Champion 'Thunder-Tail' vs. Challenger 'Rusty'. Betting strictly in dry beans and brass washers. Sentry patrols will be paid 2 ounces of lard to look at the periscope.
We cannot sew hazmat suit seams in the dark. Tallow candles smell like dead goat and smoke out the needle eyes. Give us two paraffin lanterns or we stop patching airlock gaskets.
To The Keeper (104.7 MHz): Please play 'The Blue Danube' again on Thursday night. Stoker Fyodor promises not to bang the ash shovel during the cello part.
postings.morale_effect: +15 Nostalgic hope; Keeper plays the waltz

postings.content: A yellow coltsfoot sprouted through the condensation drain on Exhaust Louver 2. It has five leaves and smells like fresh lemon. I tied a string around the stem so no one sweeps it away. Life is stubborn.
The diesel generator does not have 'a funny squeak in its soul.' It has a worn thrust washer on Cylinder 3. Stop pouring salad oil into the governor linkage and let me sleep.

postings.medium: White lime paste cross with dates
postings.content: The fire on the hills was the purge of pride. Those who hoard the wheat will choke on the chaff. Forgive the flyers of the planes, for they burned with the cities.

postings.medium: Iron gall ink on parchment scrap
postings.content: Official Review of 'Roast Chicory & Dandelion Root Tea': Color: Muddy riverbed. Aroma: Wet boot leather. Taste: High-explosive residue. Aftertaste: Regret. Score: 10/10, will drink two cups tomorrow.

Lost: Thin gold band engraved 'A. + P. — 1982' down the drain in Shower 3. If found by the sump cleaning crew, please return to Scout Quarters. Reward: 1 bar of real lavender soap from the surface cache.
postings.morale_effect: Sump crew disassembles trap and finds ring (+15 Morale)

postings.medium: Carved into oak plank with bayonet
postings.content:
When the snow blows red, don't leave your bed.
When the frost turns blue, the roof leaks through.
When the mast rings clear, the spring is near.
When the bell don't chime, it's shoveling time.
We pour forty bars of pig iron per shift while the Council drinks warm kvass in the library. Double the milk ration for furnace stokers or the slag stays in the crucible tomorrow.
postings.morale_effect: Council grants extra milk (+10 Industrial stability)

postings.content: This is where we hide the poetry books and the star charts. If you finish your three hours of coal sorting, come read about the rings of Saturn. The sky is still up there, waiting.

postings.medium: Charcoal cartoon of a giant pancake
postings.content: Day 2450: The Great Rye Harvest Feast! Today every man, woman, and child gets three real rye pancakes with beet molasses. No pine bark! No clay! God bless the greenhouse crew!
postings.morale_effect: +35 Bunker-wide celebration feast (+20 Morale for 7 days)

postings.medium: Hand-lettered ink with pressed dry clover
postings.content: Notice of Marriage: Anton the Courier and Polina of the North Watch will hold their vows at 14:00 on the surface airlock roof under the open sun. All dwellers invited. Bring your own wooden spoon for the stew.
This was the last wagon of lignite shoveled in Bunker 7. From tomorrow, the valley runs on the hydro-turbine at Lock 4. Farewell to the coal dust, farewell to the soot, hello to clean water.
postings.morale_effect: +25 Clean energy pride across all shifts

postings.medium: Chiseled into stone with gold leaf inlay
postings.content: Resolved: That no child in this valley shall be sold into debt labor; that the clean water of Lock 4 belongs to all hearths equally; and that the memory of the forty-five minutes shall be carved on every threshold.

postings.location: Outer Blast Door (Open to the Sun)
postings.medium: Carved into the outer granite door jamb
postings.content: To those who come after us: We lived ten years beneath the earth so that you could walk upon it. Take care of the rye. Keep the water clean. Love one another in the daylight.
postings.morale_effect: +50 Final Victory Condition Complete (The Century Seed)
